info.title: Coinroost
info.description: Personal finance for one household: accounts, transactions, imports.

post.summary:
Imports a bank file into an account, with the account's profile. Transactions already in the account are
skipped; rows that cannot be read are reported and left out.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: The file's name, as the bank gave it.

post.summary:
Shows what importing a bank file would do, without importing it: the account it belongs to (found from the
file unless named), every transaction read and whether the account already has it, and the rows that cannot
be read.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: The file's name, as the bank gave it.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account to read the file for; when absent, the account is found from the file.

422.description: The file cannot be read with the account's profile

422.description: The name is empty or too long

post.summary: Adds a rule at a position.

422.description: A value is not valid or refers to nothing

post.summary: Starts a session. Every failure answers 401 the same way, whatever was wrong.

201.description: Logged in; the token is also set as a cookie

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Only transactions with a leg on this account.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, newest first (default 100, at most 1000).

post.summary: Records a transaction: one leg, or a transfer of two legs on different accounts that sum to zero.

422.description: The legs or a reference are not valid

latest.description: The date of its latest transaction, imported or not.

ranges.description: What the imported files cover, oldest first; files less than 16 days apart count as one range.

AccountMatch.description: How the preview chose the account.

Actions.description: What a matching rule sets; at least one.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the statements it reads.

Conditions.description: Conditions; every one that is set must hold, and at least one must be set.

description_contains.description: Case-insensitive text the description must contain.

amount_min.description: Smallest magnitude, in minor units, included.

amount_max.description: Largest magnitude, in minor units, included.

items.description: Every account, the most behind first.

Detection.description:
How the account's exports are recognized when several files are dropped at once. A file belongs to the
account when its header has every detection text of the profile and every marker, and, when a label or a
number hash is set, at least one of them. Cards that share a format are told apart by card prefix.

markers.description: Texts the header must also contain, such as the account name as the bank prints it.

card_prefixes.description: Card network prefixes (ISO/IEC 7812), such as `4` for Visa or `34` and `37` for American Express.

label.description: The account type as the bank prints it in the header.

number_hash.description: First 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the account number printed in the header.

Gap.description: Days with no imported file between two imported ranges.

rows_read.description: Data rows in the file, the header excluded.

first_date.description: The first and last date among the rows read, duplicates included; empty when no row could be read.

candidates.description: The accounts the file fits, when it fits several.

oneOf.description: Empty until the account is known.

row_errors.description: Rows that could not be read; they were not imported.

external_id.description: The deduplication key of an imported leg.

code.description: The 6-digit code the authenticator app shows now.

namespace.description: Lower case letters, digits, `_` and `-`; cannot change once the account has transactions.

profile.description: Id of the bank profile its exports are read with (`GET /api/v1/profiles` lists them).

amount_minor.description: Signed minor units in the account's currency: negative is money leaving the account.

posted_on.description: The bank's date for this leg; the transaction's date when absent.

position.description: Where it goes, 1 being first; the rules from there on move down one. Last when absent.

token.description: Also set as the `coinroost_session` cookie; clients without cookies send it as a bearer token.

legs.description: One leg, or two for a transfer.

amount_minor.description: Signed minor units in the account's currency: negative is money leaving the account.

duplicate.description: The account already has it: the import skips it.

Problem.description: An error response. `title` is fixed per status; `detail` says what to fix, without internals.

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the status code says it all.

Reading.description: What importing the file into the account would do.

rows.description: The transactions read, in file order.

row_errors.description: Rows that cannot be read; the import leaves them out.

rows_read.description: Data rows in the file, the header excluded.

first_date.description: The first and last date among the rows read, duplicates included.

row.description: Row number in the file, 1 being the header.
